about_the_game:
Free single player Demo Available.

Embark on Pixel Dungeon VR: Part 1, where you'll experience the first map in depth with multiplayer!

Don't forget to wishlist the game and be ready for more epic dungeon adventures!

Pixel Dungeon VR is an interactive RPG action adventure dungeon exploration game with captivating pixel art style, offering 3 maps, 5 difficulty levels, 50+ monsters, 3 bosses, 10+ types of weapons, and 30+ avatars.

Complete in-game tasks to win exclusive rewards!🎁

👐 Solo or Co-op

Solo exploration or 3-player team-up. Co-op multiplayer enhances your social experience with smarter battle strategies and real-time voice chat.

🕌 Endless Dungeons

Explore randomly generated dungeons in the pixel world, offering a new challenge with each epic adventure. 3 maps, 5 difficulty levels, with more to come.

⚔️ Immersive Combat

Choose, mix and match from 10+ weapons—snipe with crossbow, wield heavy sword, throw axes... and face off against 50+ monsters and 3 epic bosses in a non-stop thrill ride!

🧝‍♂️ Diverse Avatars

Start with 30 avatars, with more designs to be determined by players. Share your ideas in Discord!

🌟 Growth System

  • Talent: Utilize the talent system to upgrade different abilities, enhance combat prowess, unlock new skills and items.

  • Weapon Crafting: Forge your own legendary gear by upgrading weapons or rerolling weapon stats.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS *: Windows 7/8.1/10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel i5-4590 / AMD Ryzen 5 1500X
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA®GeForce® GTX 1650s / AMD Radeon™ RX5300
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • VR Support: Open XR，requires motion controllers. Support Valve Index, Quest 2 and Quest 3
  • Additional Notes: VR Only
